research.name: css-doodle
research.note: A web component that draws generative patterns by applying CSS rules, randomness and math to a grid of cells.

effects: generative patterns from CSS rules applied to a grid of cells via @grid
random and indexed value pickers inside CSS (@r, @p, @pn, @n)
SVG written in nested CSS syntax via @svg
pattern DSL compiled to a GPU shader via @pattern
clip-path shapes generated from math equations via @shape

unverified: The live site could not be opened in a browser (navigation aborted); demoViewed rests on the two README screenshots (hero.png and example.png), which I viewed as static images.
The @svg, @pattern (GPU shader) and @shape effects were read from the text of css-doodle.com via a text fetch, not seen rendered.
The animation in the hero doodle (blinking eyes via @keyframes) is in the linked code but was only seen as a still image.
requiresHostedService false is inferred from it being an npm-distributed web component; I did not install or run it.
Section gems is a judgment call; at about 6k stars it may not count as lesser-known.
